title: Act I — Spark
subtitle: The Genesis
content: Greece, 2012. SAfA discovers blockchain during financial turmoil. He sets up his first mining rig, rides a bull run, gets crushed by Mt. Gox. He realises: decentralisation needs guardians.

title: Act II — Formation
subtitle: The Team Assembles
content: Niva brings cryptography expertise. Kyra builds digital shields. Luna keeps infrastructure alive. Together they thwart the Dark Node's first attacks on promising altcoins.

title: Act III — Revelation
subtitle: The Defector
content: Zayne Nexus appears with critical intelligence: the Dark Node is not just attacking coins — they're targeting Greece's experimental decentralised civic stack. The threat is bigger than anyone imagined.

title: Act IV — Uplift
subtitle: The Siege of Agora
content: The final battle. DDoS attacks on the voting protocol. Media FUD campaigns. Physical sabotage attempts. The Hunters must split up and defend all fronts simultaneously. Victory is hard-won, but Zayne warns: this was just one node of the hydra.
